description: War & Conflict Monitor: the War & Conflict Index, a monthly measure of organised violence (wars, insurgencies, armed-group fighting, attacks on civilians) for 47 economies, their regions and the world, from two components, the higher of which sets the reading: deaths (Uppsala Conflict Data Program, 25 points per tenfold rise in monthly deaths, 100 = 10,000+ a month; deaths abroad involving the state's forces count half) and strikes (GDELT reports of air strikes, missiles, drones, bombings and artillery, fatal or not, vs the economy's own 2015-2019 normal: 3x = 25, 6x = 50, 12x = 75). 0 = no organised violence; bands None/Low/Elevated/High/War. Violence only: no geopolitical tension or threat measures. Returns the reading, deaths at home and abroad, main conflicts, history, a military operations tempo gauge (news reports of combat operations by its own forces, with theatres abroad; not in the index), the defence economy (US defence orders/output/spending, European defence spending % GDP, aerospace & defence stocks), a shipping-spillover panel (not in the index) and a pooled test of GDP growth and nowcast misses by conflict level. Give economy (ru, ng, mx, ...) or an aggregate slug (world, latin-america-caribbean, ...).

economy.description: Economy code or aggregate slug; omit for the world view with every economy

months.description: Months of history to return (latest last)
